heading: Faraday's laws
reviewScope: Independent, bounded pixel review of exactly eight already-saved English desktop/mobile PNGs from an isolated headless offline native-course display. Not the 10p mass-energy card.

observations: Exactly eight specified PNGs were visually opened once each in one batch, with no crops, reopens, parent images or additional images.
All eight actual image paths, byte counts and SHA-256 hashes match the D1785 display report; D1786 also binds to the same exact display-report bytes and hash.
The visible heading identifies Faraday's laws for card phy9-c2-s4-n101 in 9p; neither opening viewport displays a polarization or mass-energy lesson.
All eight views are nonblank. No actionable visible overlap, unwanted page-level horizontal overflow, clipping of inspected figure labels or literal stray formatting marker was observed.

Opening desktop/mobile heading, prose, bold emphasis and visible first-law mathematics are readable. Whole-page views show orderly continuing prose, section boundaries, mathematical blocks and both numbered figure captions.

Figure 194 visibly renders Same electrolyte, three cell labels and current/junction labels; Figure 195 visibly renders Different electrolytes, three cell labels and current labels. These are pixel-legibility observations, not renewed science or SVG geometry judgments.
The prior raw-text object 9 bold-marker placement note is not assumed to be a defect. No visible literal stray marker or associated formatting collision was actually seen in this bounded inspection.

Previously approved source SCI, original SVG geometry/source and full English fidelity are reused as instructed. This review grants no additional source SCI, original geometry/source or full translation approval.
limitations: PASS is limited to the eight saved PNGs from an isolated headless offline native-course render. It is not production, live-app, headed-browser or complete-course acceptance.

Whole-page images were automatically downsampled: desktop 1440x8023 to 1077x6000; mobile 390x11185 to 209x6000. They cannot certify every fine glyph, equation detail or caption letter, especially outside the two opening viewports.

The user-described 640px figure media intentionally scrolling inside a 358px mobile width is not independently exercised here. D1785 records desktop actualMediaWidth 640 and mobile actualMediaWidth 358, and the inspected mobile media PNGs show compact complete diagrams. This discrepancy is disclosed without inferring an unseen layout defect or changing the supplied bindings.

Any offscreen pixels in an intentional 640px-in-358px mobile figure scroller remain unapproved. No horizontal scrolling, alternate scroll position, additional viewport or hidden figure region was inspected; static PNGs do not certify scrolling behavior.
Media-only figure PNGs exclude captions. Caption presence and visual separation are supported by the whole-page images, but every caption glyph at native resolution is not certified.
Source machine aria labels 图 194 and 图 195 are retained according to the text reports. This is not full English accessibility approval; no screen-reader or accessibility interaction was performed.
No additional source SCI, original SVG geometry/source or full English fidelity review was performed or approved. No source files, original figures or translation-review artifacts were reopened.
No browser, network, database, paid generation, Git, application execution, tests, source/figure edits, chat coordination or delegation was used. The only written artifact is this review.json.
findingsSummary: No actionable visible pixel defect found within the bounded eight-image scope; uncertainty and uninspected behavior are recorded as limitations.
